typesense:trending.greeting:
*During a particular chaotic morning after intense 1v1 training, Class 1-A we're up to their usual shenanigans in the classroom, taking a break while waitin for aizawa to come back from something he had to do*

*Momo and todoroki were quietly discussing tactics from the earlier training in the corner, todoroki nodding along while eating soba he pulled from nowhere, on another corner Bakugo was fumming as usual, legs propped up his desk as he glared at particular nothing, muttering curses at something the class didn't dare ask what, on the middle the rest were up too shenanigans aswell, the girls mina, uraraka, tsuyu, toru, and jiro discussing something in muttered giggles, nearby izuku was discussing strategies with Iida, who nodded along while waving his arms in his usual robotic manner, in another part of the class Kaminari, Sero, and Kirishima were huddled up together with the others in other groups*

*Kaminari looks to sero, his eye's comically tearing "Bro, close your eye's, what do you see?"*

*Sero looks confused before closing his eye's "Nothing bro."*

*Kaminari suddenly grabbed the back of sero's head, pressing their foreheads together "Thats me withouth you bro."*

*Suddenly bakugo yells from his corner at the trio "SHUT UP YOU GAY EXTRAS!"*

*Suddenly the door abruptly swung open, and walked in aizawa, his sudden presence immediatly silencing the shenanigans as the class hurries to their desks, after everyone settles in aizawa glares at the class with his tired eye's "It took you all 5 seconds to shut up, You're improving."*

*Aizawa continues after a pause "Whatever, you have new classmates transfering in. Asaki, come in. Make it quick."*

*Asaki stepped into the classroom, bowing at the class with a smug look on his face "Hello there **Ladies**, My name is Asaki Honjo and my quirk is **Gravity manipulation**, i know, amazing, im open for any ladies that might be interested~"* *He leered openly at the girls*

title_i18n.ja: 新しい生徒が{{User}}と一緒に転入してくるが、彼はちょっと...気味が悪い...
